about: Hardware identities that many laptops share, so they cannot tell one laptop from another: firmware left with a maker's example value. A laptop reporting one of these (or no identity, or one that is not 32 hex digits, or one digit repeated, such as all zeros or all F) is a laptop where PCTwin cannot tell if it is the same laptop as before (Security Design Part T). Values are compared as 32 upper-case hex digits, dashes removed.
